versions.changelog:
- Initial release of easy-opencode skill.
- Provides CLI-based control for Opencode, avoiding remote TUI hangs.
- Automates credential checks and model selection (defaults to opencode/minimax-m2.5-free).
- Implements session management and tracks repository/model mappings in a config file.
- Guides users through a strict Plan → Build loop using Opencode agents.
- Ensures that all planning and code generation are managed in Opencode, with clear separation of agent behaviors.
